frame_time: t = frame / 30.005455 ; frame = round(t * fps). Last frame 53 = 1.766 s
units: pixels (x right, y down, origin top-left) and seconds; no metric scale assumed

camera.motion: static (phase correlation of the wall vs frame 0: |shift| < 0.02 px in every frame)
camera.orientation: level, image plane parallel to the building facade and the street (facade verticals vertical, window widths identical in both rows, all ground lines horizontal)
camera.horizon_note: no visible horizon; for a level camera it is at the principal-point row (assumed image centre y=540). Ground surfaces (sidewalk top, road) are seen from above, consistent with that.

orange_car.reference_point: ref_x = midpoint between the two wheel axles (wheel centres from Hough circles), ref_y = axle height y=929. Vehicle-root proxy; the rig root is probably near this x (ground level, y~982) - its vertical position is constant so speeds only depend on x
